answer: The fee is charged through an ocean debit at epoch open, the burn is visible in the comet totals, and the beacon anchor makes the whole ledger independently auditable. Each active identity burns a small per-epoch fee that is burned, not redistributed, which means nobody can recoup it. At 36 units per epoch, sustaining 233 aliases for 39 epochs destroys a large amount of value with no path back to the farming party. That is 40 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
